articles.title: Russian online retail warehouses hit by deadly Ukrainian strikes
articles.description: Drones targeted Wildberries facilities near Moscow and in Tambov. Ukraine's leader called them "major logistics facilities" supplying "sanctioned components".

articles.title: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night
articles.description: Iran has retaliated against US allies in the region, with Kuwait reporting that a power and water plant had been hit.

articles.title: Indian activist on hunger strike for 20 days forcibly taken to hospital
articles.description: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke has now begun an indefinite fast in Sonam Wangchuk's place.

articles.title: One anti-war critic fined, another held as Russia clamps down on dissent
articles.description: While Boris Nadezhdin is barred from running for parliament, blogger Ilya Remeslo is remanded in custody.

articles.title: Magnitude 7.3 earthquake quake strikes off Mexico coast
articles.description: The US Tsunami Warning Center has recorded waves 0.3m (1.1 feet) high in Puerto Madero and Chiapas in Mexico after the quake.

articles.title: Trump alleges China meddled in 2020 election and questions voting security ahead of midterms
articles.description: China said Trump's claims were fabricated and US Democrats said he was paving the way to undermine November's elections.

articles.title: Hunger striker taken to hospital as police launch 'chilling crackdown'
articles.description: Police have forcibly removed hunger striker Sonam Wangchuk from a student protest site in India.

articles.title: Russia is the only winner from Ukraine's internal war
articles.description: An extraordinary rupture at the heart of Ukraine's top war-fighting team is a dangerous moment for the country that can only benefit Russia.
